name: NBHM Master's Scholarship and Doctoral Scholarship (Mathematics)
provider: National Board for Higher Mathematics, Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India

rules.quote: The name of the degree that it leads to contains at least one of: “Mathematics”, “Statistics”, “Mathematical Science(s)”.
The test serves as the first stage of a two-stage selection process for the following scholarships

rules.value: full-time qualifying programme at accredited Indian institution
rules.quote: It is a recognised full-time programme offered by an accredited university or institution in India
It is open only to Indian nationals and is administered through the scholar’s institution.

value: NBHM Scholarship Written Test and interview
rules.quote: Be selected via the written test and Master’s interview, and

rules.value: not for those who previously drew the Master's Scholarship
rules.quote: Not have previously drawn the NBHM Master’s Scholarship.

amount.text: Master's: Rs 8,000 per month for up to two years. Doctoral: Rs 37,000 per month (first two years), Rs 42,000 thereafter, plus Rs 40,000 yearly contingency
amount.quote: A monthly stipend Rs 8,000 is payable for up to two years.
